text:
Added modules/protocol/src/test/resources/fixtures/agent-scheduler-shapes-v1.json plus a provenance file, and AgentSchedulerShapeSuite. The fixture pins 28 distinct Scala case names that circe-generic currently places on the agent wire, covering every case of Submission, SubmissionAttempt, AcceptanceUncertainty, InvocationResult, SpawnFailureKind, CancellationResult, CancellationAttempt, SchedulerQueryResult, SchedulerCapabilities and CapabilitySupport, plus the JobRef/EvidenceBundle/BoundedEvidence/EvidenceSource/Diagnostic shapes they nest. Evidence bytes include 0x00/0x7F/0x80/0xFF so base64 handling is pinned too. A second test asserts decode round trips for every value.

Regeneration is gated behind -Dscalaslurm.regenerateShapeFixture=true and fails the run afterwards, so it cannot be used to make a failing build pass.

Evidence: renamed Submission.AcceptanceUnknown to AcceptanceUncertain across the whole tree exactly as an IDE refactor would, and the suite failed with a byte diff naming the changed discriminator. Before this bead that rename compiled, tested, mima-checked and formatted clean. Rename reverted; full gate green (scalafmtAll, 285 tests, mimaReportBinaryIssues, doc).
